family_title_en: Complete the word with the correct initial consonant blend

stages.ix_title: Complete the word with the correct initial consonant blend

prompt.en: Which blend completes the last word?

stages.choice_rule: Four unique lowercase choices from bl, br, cl, cr, dr, fl, fr, gl, gr, pl, pr, sc, sk, sl, sm, sn, sp, st, sw, tr, scr, spr, str, squ, thr. Take a real kid word, remove its longest blend from that set, and put only the ending as the last stem token. The correct choice is the blend you removed. The sentence fits that one word and no other blend word. Do not write the finished word in the stem. Tier 1 wrong blends share no letter with the answer. Tier 2 wrong blends are the same length and share exactly one letter. Tier 3 wrong blends each drop, add, or change one letter. No digraphs, misspellings, science, or two. The ending is at least two letters.

gold_items.stem: She is my very best iend.
I saw a little pet ake.
I eat soup with a oon.
My little sister just got a new red ayon.
<NAME> has a big dog and is ong.

roots: The correct choice is the longest allowed blend removed from the last token to make one real word.
Wrong choices are other blends from the allowed set, in lowercase, never whole words and never single letters.
Do not use the digraphs ch, sh, th, or wh. The blend thr is allowed. Never treat two as tw, and never use science as sc.
Tier 1 wrong blends share no letter with the correct blend.
Tier 2 wrong blends keep the same length and share exactly one letter with the correct blend.
Tier 3 wrong blends each drop, add, or change exactly one letter of the correct blend.
Use a correct kid spelling about home, school, food, pets, play, family, or weather. Skip misspellings, brands, and real names.
If a stem needs a child, write <NAME>. The finished word must not appear anywhere in the stem.

tier_rules.1: Four to six words. The last token is the ending of a common one-syllable word. Wrong blends share no letter with the answer.
tier_rules.2: Six to eight words. The last token is the ending of a grade-level word. Each wrong blend is the same length and shares exactly one letter.
tier_rules.3: Seven to ten words. Use a two-syllable word or a three-letter blend. Each wrong blend drops, adds, or changes one letter.
